basics.name: Namrata G. Laddha
basics.label: Avionics & Power Electronics Engineer
basics.summary: Avionics and power electronics engineer for space systems. Graduate researcher at USC working on planetary rovers, CubeSat electronics, and liquid rocket engine instrumentation. Propulsion control electronics I designed flew aboard ISRO's POEM mission on PSLV-C60 in December 2024.

courses: Space Exploration Architectures Concept Synthesis Studio
Honors in Artificial Intelligence, Computer Vision & Robotics (2020-2024)

work.name: Laboratory for Autonomous Systems in Exploration and Robotics (LASER), USC
work.summary: Electrical and software lead for two NASA CADRE-class rovers used as the experimental platform for multi-agent control algorithm research.
highlights: Architecting the power system, RS485 motor bus, sensor fabric, and Jetson Orin Nano compute stack
Supporting synchronized navigation, SLAM, and inter-rover coordination studies

work.name: Space Engineering Research Center, Information Sciences Institute, USC
work.summary: Hardware and software for the MAVERIC CubeSat electronics subsystem.
highlights: Developing and implementing electronics subsystem components against mission requirements
Building GNU Radio flowgraphs for a reliable CubeSat-to-ground-station link

work.name: Liquid Propulsion Laboratory, USC
work.summary: Data acquisition and instrumentation for a liquid rocket engine test stand.
highlights: Designing DAQ and instrumentation to capture sensor data and actuator control for real-time performance metrics
Defining the sensor architecture to improve test safety

work.name: Manastu Space Technologies Pvt. Ltd.
work.summary: Flight electronics for green propulsion systems.
highlights: Designed and delivered flight-ready propulsion control electronics using STM32 and RS485, flown aboard ISRO's POEM mission (PSLV-C60, December 2024)
Performed FMECA, QA/QC, EMI/EMC, and environmental qualification to ISRO standards
Lead Avionics Engineer for the IDEX mission with the Defense Space Agency: PCB design, project management, system integration, test and validation

work.name: Manastu Space Technologies Pvt. Ltd.
work.summary: Electrical power system research for propulsion modules.
highlights: Researched and developed low-cost, low-EMI electrical power system solutions for a propulsion module, reducing projected hardware costs by 15%
Evaluated and tested COTS components, validating functionality and space compliance for integration into the propulsion system architecture

projects.name: Model Rocket with Thrust Vectoring and Recovery System
projects.description: Model rocket with a dual-servo thrust vectoring mechanism, servo-actuated hexagonal parachute recovery, reusable combustion chamber, and a custom Arduino flight computer. Achieved 384 N peak thrust and 320 N-s total impulse.

projects.name: Payload Optimization Autonomous Drone
projects.description: Designed and fabricated a custom flight control PCB integrating high-current motor drive circuits and a sensor array for real-time embedded execution of constraint-based flight control, targeting emergency package delivery.

publications.name: Design and Development of a Model Rocket with Recovery System and Thrust Vectoring for Enhanced Performance and Stability
publications.summary: S. Thorat, N. Laddha, N. Mehendale, S. R. Nikam.

publications.name: Improving Drone Efficiency for Emergency Package Delivery through Payload Optimization and Traffic Avoidance
publications.summary: N. Laddha, S. Bhattacharjee, O. Dekate, N. Mehendale. First author.
